boundary: Real Django API and browser cookies; email delivered only to isolated local file spool. No live Google or Telegram provider calls.
checks: Real registration sends local email, requires correct verification code and creates a verified email-only account
Email/password login in a separate browser session resolves the original account
Password change preserves current account/session and invalidates the other browser session
Real reset email/code sets a new password; subsequent sign-in preserves the same account
Real account settings render EN/UZ/RU at mobile width without overflow
